int_name: N CARLISLE ST & W HUNTINGDON ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by an industrial setting with a narrow sidewalk interrupted by a large, active garage entrance. The lack of marked crossings, traffic control devices, and street lighting creates a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Industrial Driveway
hazards.description: The large open garage bay creates a significant conflict point where vehicles may exit across the sidewalk without clear sightlines of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right of the image, the large open bay.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style marked crosswalk to designate a safe crossing area and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Driveway Safety Enhancements
interventions.description: Install 'Watch for Pedestrians' signage and high-visibility pavement markings at the garage exit to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility of the sidewalk and potential conflict zones at night.

result.summary: The street environment provides basic pedestrian access via sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any formal crossing infrastructure or traffic control at the visible intersection. The presence of parked vehicles along the curb creates significant visual obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space or priority for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb block the visibility between drivers and pedestrians entering the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking lanes on both sides of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow one-way street with sidewalks on both sides, though the left walkway is heavily obstructed by large dumpsters. A modern curb ramp with tactile paving is visible in the foreground, but the intersection lacks marked crosswalks and traffic control signals.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large dumpsters block the pedestrian path on the left side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalks at the intersection reduces driver awareness and pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and dumpsters may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Relocate dumpsters to an off-street location to restore the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The street provides continuous sidewalks on both sides but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure or roadway markings. The industrial character and presence of parked vehicles create potential sightline hazards for pedestrians in an otherwise low-speed environment.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked locations for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right curb and the school bus ahead can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street and center background

hazards.name: Lack of lane markings
hazards.description: The absence of center lines or lane markings can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning on the roadway.
